The '''1966–67 [[Serie A]]''' season was won by [[Juventus]], it was their second scudetto of the 1960s. The season was closely contested and went down to the final day of the season; [[Inter Milan|Internazionale]] were left needing just a draw or having Juventus not beat [[S.S. Lazio|Lazio]] to win the title. However, Inter lost 1–0 on the final day to [[A.C. Mantova|Mantova]] thanks to a goal from one of their former players, [[Beniamino Di Giacomo]]. Juventus on the other hand beat Lazio 2–1 to take their 13th title.

==Teams==
[[Venezia FC|Venezia]], [[Calcio Lecco|Lecco]] and [[AC Mantova|Mantova]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].

==Events==
A transitional relegation place was added to reduce the league to 16 clubs.

Six out of the eighteen clubs came from [[Lombardy]], a record for a single [[region of Italy]].
